subject: AppSec provider evaluation + migration plan
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: AppSec vendor shortlist and migration timeline

Dev —

Quick note to kick off procurement for our FY27 appsec program. As we discussed in last week's leadership sync, we want to move from ad-hoc annual pen tests to a more continuous program that covers:

- External pen test (annual) focused on auth flows and public APIs
- Red team exercise (once per year, targeted scenarios)
- Application dependency and IaC review (lightweight)
- Remediation verification windows and retest policy

Priority items for procurement: vendor must provide a clear SOW with milestones, SLA for report delivery, remediation verification included (no extra charge for one retest), and standard cyber insurance (min $5M). Security needs to see methodology and at least two references from SaaS vendors with similar stack.

I've shortlisted three firms: Acme Security, Sentinel Labs, and GreyMatter. Can you:

1) Open the conversations with each and ask for a draft SOW + ballpark pricing
2) Confirm their insurance and SOC2 (if applicable)
3) Schedule vendor calls next week (Dec 8-10) for initial fit

Target: decide vendor and have a signed SOW by end of December so engagement can start in early Jan.

Thanks,

Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Security
Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Iris Wu <iris.wu@acme-sec.com>, sales@acme-sec.com
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-05T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Intro: Redwood AppSec RFP — call request

Hi Iris / Acme team —

Quick intro: I manage vendor engagements for security and infra at Redwood. Lauren (cc'd) and the security team are looking to replace our annual pen test vendor with a partner that can run a hybrid program (external pen test, one red-team exercise, dependency/IaC review, and remediation verification).

Can you please provide availability for a 30–45 minute call next week (Dec 8–10) to walk through:

- High-level methodology for external test + red team
- Typical timeline and deliverables (draft report -> final + retest)
- Ballpark pricing or pricing model (fixed SOW vs retainer)
- Insurance, IP, and confidentiality terms

I've attached our vendor questionnaire to help you scope (vendor-questionnaire-2026.xlsx). If you can return a preliminary quote and an example SOW before the call that will speed things up.

Also note the following non-negotiables: retest included for verified fixes, liability insurance >= $5M, and ability to start discovery in early January.

Thanks — happy to coordinate times.

Best,
Dev Patel
Vendor Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: vendor-questionnaire-2026.xlsx
From: Iris Wu <iris.wu@acme-sec.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: sales@acme-sec.com, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-05T15:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood AppSec RFP — call request

On Sat, Dec 5, 2026 at 10:05 AM Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Can you please provide availability for a 30–45 minute call next week (Dec 8–10) to walk through:...

Thanks for the intro, Dev and team — pleased to meet you virtually. Acme can cover the scope you outlined. High-level response below and attached materials.

Summary of approach (very high level):
1) Discovery & scoping (1–2 weeks): asset inventory, threat model review, target lists
2) External penetration test (2 weeks): authenticated + unauthenticated testing focused on APIs and auth flows
3) Red team (3–4 weeks, overlaps with remediation): targeted scenarios agreed in discovery — includes social engineering if requested (separate add-on)
4) Remediation verification (retrospective retest included for items flagged as 'validated fixed' within six weeks)

Pricing (ballpark):
- External pen test + report: $28k–$38k (depends on asset count & auth complexity)
- Red team add-on: $40k–$65k (scope dependent)
- Multi-year package (annual pen + red team): 10% discount on list pricing

Attachments (stubs): Acme-Quote-2026-12-05.pdf, Acme-approach.pdf

We carry $10M general liability + $10M cyber liability. Typical SOW terms include deliverable SLA (draft within 10 business days of test completion, final within 15), IP: vendor retains test techniques, customer retains findings/results; all output treated as confidential. We are happy to negotiate specific contract language on indemnity and insurance.

Available times for a 30–45m call (PST):
- Tue Dec 8: 9:30–11:00, 14:00–16:00
- Wed Dec 9: 10:00–12:00

Iris Wu
Director, Strategic Accounts
Acme Security

Attachments: Acme-Quote-2026-12-05.pdf; Acme-approach.pdf
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-06T15:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: AppSec provider evaluation + migration plan

Team —

After reviewing Acme's quote and approach (and comparing to the other two bids), I'm leaning toward moving forward with Acme on a multi-year package. Pros:
- Coverage matches our ask (external tests + red team + retest)
- Liability and cyber insurance levels exceed the minimum
- Clear deliverable SLAs in the template SOW

Remaining asks before procurement signs:
1) Amend SOW: explicit remediation retest SLA (7 business days turnaround for verification after vendor confirms fix)
2) Add a carve-out for third-party consumer data handling in the data processing clause (security to provide language)
3) Confirm DocuSign route and PO process — procurement to submit PO against the SOW; vendor to accept PO + DocuSign SOW
4) Ask Acme for a two-year price lock with an option to cancel after year one with 30 days' notice (to keep flexibility)

I've attached a first-pass SOW draft for review: SOW-draft-acme-2026-12-06.docx. Dev — can you please lead vendor negotiations on the above items and loop procurement? Hannah / Lauren — please send the exact DP clause you want included and we can feed that into the SOW.

Target: execution by Dec 23 so we can start discovery the week of Jan 5.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
VP, Platform Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW-draft-acme-2026-12-06.docx
